name: Randomized Littlestone Dimension of Half-intervals
proof: A threshold query partitions the feasible initial segments at any chosen cut, so shattered trees for this class are precisely binary comparison trees with n leaves. If $F(n)$ is the largest expected random-branch depth among such trees, then $F(1)=0$ and $F(n)=1+\max_{1\leq a<n}(F(a)+F(n-a))/2$. Induction gives $F(n)=k+(n-2^k)/2^k$ for $k=\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor$. Dividing by two gives the stated randomized Littlestone value.
